name: Haruna Shouko
source:
A doctor and the Deputy Director of the Setou Underground Institute of Science (Her father is the director).
She has taken upon herself the guidance and supervision of the 4 people who have special abilities. (Natsuru, Yui, Shuuya and Takato)

[Roughly translated from [url=http://cla.velvet.jp/kasou1.htm]the official site[/url].]
